description: 阅读理解：基于课文的选择题，检验理解程度

questions.question: What's Su Hai's plan for the weekend?
questions.questionCn: 苏海周末的计划是什么？

options.label: B
options.text: She'll go plogging with her family.
options.textCn: 她要和家人去慢跑捡垃圾。

questions.explanation: 课文说：I'll go plogging with my family. 我要和家人一起去慢跑捡垃圾。

questions.question: What is plogging?

options.label: C
options.text: It's jogging and picking up rubbish at the same time.
options.textCn: 就是同时慢跑和捡垃圾。

questions.explanation: 课文说：It's jogging and picking up rubbish at the same time. 就是同时慢跑和捡垃圾。

questions.question: What can plogging do?

options.label: B
options.text: It can keep us healthy and make our city clean.
options.textCn: 它既能让我们保持健康，又能让城市变干净。

options.label: D
options.text: It can make the city dirty.

questions.explanation: 课文说：It can keep us healthy and make our city clean. 它既能让我们保持健康，又能让城市变干净。

questions.question: Where will they meet?
questions.explanation: 课文说：Let's meet at the school gate at nine o'clock. 我们九点在学校门口集合吧。

questions.question: What time will they meet?
questions.explanation: 课文说：Let's meet at the school gate at nine o'clock. 我们九点在学校门口集合吧。

questions.question: What did they do in the park?
questions.questionCn: 他们在公园里做了什么？

options.label: B
options.text: They jogged and picked up rubbish.

questions.explanation: 课文说：They jogged and picked up rubbish together. 他们一起慢跑，一起捡垃圾。

questions.question: Did they enjoy plogging?

options.label: A
options.text: Yes, they did. They want to do it again.

options.label: B
options.text: No, they didn't. It was tiring.

questions.explanation: 课文最后说：Let's go plogging again next weekend! 我们下周末再去吧！说明他们很喜欢这项活动。

questions.question: What did Bobby throw on the ground?
questions.explanation: 课文说：Bobby throws a banana skin on the ground. Bobby把一块香蕉皮扔在了地上。

questions.question: Why shouldn't we throw rubbish on the ground?
questions.questionCn: 为什么我们不应该把垃圾扔在地上？

options.label: A
options.text: Because it makes the street dirty.

options.label: C
options.text: Because it's good for the city.

options.label: D
options.textCn: 因为它让人们保持健康。

questions.explanation: 课文说：It makes the street dirty. 它把街道弄脏了。乱扔垃圾还可能导致别人滑倒受伤。

questions.question: What happened to Willy?

options.label: A
options.text: He picked up the banana skin.

options.label: B
options.text: He slipped on the banana skin and fell down.
options.textCn: 他踩在香蕉皮上滑倒了。

questions.explanation: 课文说：Willy slipped on the banana skin and fell down. Willy踩在香蕉皮上滑倒了。

questions.question: How did Willy feel after falling down?
questions.explanation: 课文说：My arm hurts a little. 我的胳膊有点疼。

questions.question: What did Bobby learn from this?
questions.questionCn: Bobby从这件事中学到了什么？

options.label: B
options.text: He shouldn't throw rubbish on the ground.
options.textCn: 他不应该把垃圾扔在地上。

questions.explanation: Bobby说：I shouldn't throw rubbish on the ground. 我不应该把垃圾扔在地上。他认识到了自己的错误。

questions.question: What should we do to keep our city clean?
questions.questionCn: 我们应该怎样保持城市清洁？

options.label: B
options.text: Pick up rubbish and don't throw it on the ground.

questions.explanation: 课文告诉我们：We should keep our city clean. 不乱扔垃圾、随手捡垃圾，都是保持城市清洁的好方法。

questions.question: What is the main idea of this unit?
questions.questionCn: 这个单元的主旨是什么？

options.label: B
options.text: We should keep our city clean and protect the environment.
options.textCn: 我们应该保持城市清洁，保护环境。

questions.explanation: 无论是plogging活动还是Bobby扔香蕉皮的故事，都告诉我们：保持城市清洁、爱护环境是每个人的责任。

questions.question: Which sentence uses the future tense (will)?
questions.questionCn: 哪个句子使用了一般将来时（will）？

options.label: A
options.text: They jogged and picked up rubbish.

options.label: B
options.text: I'll go plogging with my family.
options.textCn: 我要和家人去慢跑捡垃圾。

options.label: D
options.text: Our city is clean and beautiful.
options.textCn: 我们的城市干净又美丽。

questions.explanation: I'll = I will，will + 动词原形是一般将来时的结构，表示将要做的事情。
